title: The Kenites Settle Down and Judah Continues the Conquests
description:
The descendants of the Kenites, Moses' father-in-law's clan, set out from the City of Palms with Judah's sons and settle in the Negev of Judah near Arad.  
Judah and his brother Simeon defeat the Canaanites at Zephath, devote the city to destruction, and rename it Hormah.  
Judah takes Gaza, Ashkelon, and Ekron along with their surrounding territories.  
The Lord is with Judah, and they drive out the inhabitants of the hill country, but cannot dislodge those in the valley because they have iron chariots.  
Hebron is given to Caleb, as Moses had said, and he drives out the three sons of Anak.
